answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the prism log makes public the live set and the inlet audit records each lapse. Keeping 187 aliases alive therefore means 187 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the echo quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 639 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
